description: Run partial evaluation on a query -- substitute known values and return the residual policy. Defaults `unknowns` to `["input"]` (treat input as unknown), so the residual encodes "given input X, this is what would have to be true." Use this for offline policy slicing or pre-computing decision sets.

inputPath.description: Path to a JSON input file. Mutually exclusive with `input`.

partial.description: Run partial evaluation rather than full evaluation.

paths.description: Policy / data file or directory paths. Each must be inside an allowed root.

source.description: Inline Rego policy source. Optional: without `source` or `paths` the query runs on its own, which is enough to try a built-in or an expression.

strictBuiltinErrors.description: Treat builtin errors as fatal instead of returning undefined.

unknowns.description: Refs to treat as unknown during partial evaluation.

v0Compatible.description: Read the policy as Rego v0 (`--v0-compatible`), the syntax OPA used before 1.0: rules without `if`, partial sets as `deny[msg] { ... }`. Needed for a policy that has not been migrated, which OPA 1.x otherwise refuses to load. Where the tool also takes a query, the query is read as v0 too, with the future keywords imported so `in`, `every` and `some x in` still work in it.

name: rego_compile_query
title: Partially evaluate a Rego query
